info.company: Gaotu Techedu Inc. American Depositary Shares

about: Gaotu Techedu Inc. operates as a technology-driven education company in the People's Republic of China. It provides AI-powered product-led learning solutions for learners from pre-school to adulthood. Its learning services include traditional learning services, non-academic tutoring services, and college student and adult education services; and educational content and digitalized learning products comprise books and digitalized auxiliary learning tools. The company creates learning experiences delivered through online and offline channels. The company was formerly known as GSX Techedu Inc. and changed its name to Gaotu Techedu Inc. in June 2021. Gaotu Techedu Inc. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.
